summary: Extends the Sieve mail filtering language with the ability to check whether a mailbox exists, read mailbox and server metadata annotations, and control whether fileinto creates a mailbox that is missing. It builds on the base Sieve language in RFC 5228.

eli5.summary: Sieve is a set of rules that sorts your email into folders. This note lets those rules check whether a folder exists, read notes about folders, and create the folder if it is missing.
